client/src/components/forms/FieldConfigD.name: Field settings
client/src/components/forms/FieldConfigD.description: Sets up one form question: its label, answer type, rules, choices and where the answer is kept.

client/src/components/forms/FieldsPanel..name: Form fields panel
client/src/components/forms/FieldsPanel..description: Lists a form's questions and lets an author add, change or remove them.

client/src/components/forms/FieldsPanelD.name: Form field builder
client/src/components/forms/FieldsPanelD.description: Lets an author build a form by dragging questions into place, with a live preview alongside.

client/src/components/forms/FileUploadFi.name: File upload question
client/src/components/forms/FileUploadFi.description: Adds a file question to a form, checking size and type before the file is sent.

client/src/components/forms/FormCaptcha..name: Spam protection
client/src/components/forms/FormCaptcha..description: Adds a human check to a public form so automated submissions are turned away.

client/src/components/forms/FormConfirma.name: Thank-you message
client/src/components/forms/FormConfirma.description: Shows the confirmation someone sees after submitting a form, with their answers filled in.

client/src/components/forms/FormConfirma.name: Confirmation message editor
client/src/components/forms/FormConfirma.description: Lets an author write the thank-you message shown after someone submits the form.

client/src/components/forms/FormContextP.name: Form context viewer
client/src/components/forms/FormContextP.description: Shows the hidden values a form is working with, for admins checking a live submission.

client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedCod.name: Embed code
client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedCod.description: Gives the snippet to paste into a website so the form appears inside the page.

client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedOpt.name: Embed appearance options
client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedOpt.description: Chooses the theme and layout used when the form is embedded on a website.

client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedSec.name: Website embedding
client/src/components/forms/FormEmbedSec.description: Collects everything for putting a form on a website: the code, appearance and allowed sites.

client/src/components/forms/FormInfoDial.name: Form details
client/src/components/forms/FormInfoDial.description: Edits a form's name, description, logo, access and what happens after submission.

client/src/components/forms/FormInfoPane.name: Form summary panel
client/src/components/forms/FormInfoPane.description: Shows a form's key details and current status at a glance beside the builder.

client/src/components/forms/FormListSurf.name: Forms list
client/src/components/forms/FormListSurf.description: Lists every form with its status, owner and last change, and opens the one you pick.

client/src/components/forms/FormLogoEdit.name: Form logo
client/src/components/forms/FormLogoEdit.description: Uploads or replaces the logo shown at the top of a form.

client/src/components/forms/FormPreview..name: Form preview
client/src/components/forms/FormPreview..description: Shows the form as a visitor will see it before it goes live.

client/src/components/forms/FormPrivateL.name: Private form link
client/src/components/forms/FormPrivateL.description: Shows the private link that lets invited people open a restricted form.

client/src/components/forms/FormPublicat.name: Publish review
client/src/components/forms/FormPublicat.description: Checks a public form before it goes live and lists anything that would expose it or its answers.

client/src/components/forms/FormRenderer.name: Live form
client/src/components/forms/FormRenderer.description: Runs a form for the person filling it in: questions, checks, branching and the final submission.

client/src/components/forms/FormShareDia.name: Share form
client/src/components/forms/FormShareDia.description: Gives the link, embed code and access settings for sharing a form with the right people.

client/src/components/forms/FormSharingT.name: Form sharing switch
client/src/components/forms/FormSharingT.description: Turns public sharing of a form on or off.

client/src/components/forms/FormWebsiteR.name: Allowed websites
client/src/components/forms/FormWebsiteR.description: Limits which websites may embed the form so stray copies elsewhere stop working.

client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretCr.name: Signing secret setup
client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretCr.description: Creates a shared secret that lets an outside system prove its messages really came from it.

client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretDe.name: Delete signing secret
client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretDe.description: Confirms before removing a signing secret, after which messages signed with it are refused.

client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretLi.name: Signing secrets
client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretLi.description: Lists the shared secrets used to verify incoming messages, with when each was last used.

client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretRe.name: Show signing secret
client/src/components/forms/HmacSecretRe.description: Reveals a signing secret so it can be copied into the outside system that signs messages.

client/src/components/forms/MultiCombobo.name: Multi-choice picker
client/src/components/forms/MultiCombobo.description: Lets someone pick several values from a searchable list.

client/src/components/forms/OptionsEdito.name: Answer options editor
client/src/components/forms/OptionsEdito.description: Edits the list of choices a dropdown, radio group or checklist offers.

client/src/components/forms/Organization.name: Organization picker
client/src/components/forms/Organization.description: Lets someone choose which organization, or only themselves, a setting or record applies to.

client/src/components/forms/RolesMultiSe.name: Role picker
client/src/components/forms/RolesMultiSe.description: Lets an admin search for and pick several roles at once.

client/src/components/forms/WorkflowSele.name: Workflow picker
client/src/components/forms/WorkflowSele.description: Lets someone choose the automation a form, app or agent should run, limited to what they can see.

client/src/components/identities/BulkDel.name: Delete identities in bulk
client/src/components/identities/BulkDel.description: Removes the chosen custom identities in one go, skipping built-in ones and saying how many were kept.

client/src/components/identities/Identit.name: Identity actions
client/src/components/identities/Identit.description: Offers rename and delete for a custom identity and hides them for the built-in ones.

client/src/components/identities/Identit.name: Identity mark
client/src/components/identities/Identit.description: Shows a hexagon mark for a non-human identity where a person would show initials.

client/src/components/identities/Identit.name: Identity kind label
client/src/components/identities/Identit.description: Labels an identity as built-in, global or custom so its scope is obvious.

client/src/components/identities/Identit.name: Identity name with owner
client/src/components/identities/Identit.description: Shows an identity's mark, name and home organization, since built-in identities all share one name.

client/src/components/identities/NewIden.name: New identity
client/src/components/identities/NewIden.description: Creates a custom identity for automations to act as, with a name and home organization.

client/src/components/identities/RenameI.name: Rename identity
client/src/components/identities/RenameI.description: Renames a custom identity and explains on the spot when that name is already taken.

client/src/components/integrations/AutoM.name: Automatic matching
client/src/components/integrations/AutoM.description: Suggests which organization each connected record belongs to and applies the matches in one pass.

client/src/components/integrations/Confi.name: Connection field input
client/src/components/integrations/Confi.description: Renders one setup question for a connection in the right control for its type.
